name: claude-reflect
title_zh: 把每次纠正沉淀成永久记忆的自我进化系统
tagline_zh: 会话中你纠正它的每个错误，它都记进 CLAUDE.md。下次开场前提醒你跑 /reflect。
tagline_en: Every correction you make gets saved to CLAUDE.md. It nudges you to run /reflect before next session, turning.
desc_en: Self-learning system that captures corrections during sessions and reminds users to run /reflect to update CLAUDE.md. Use when discussing learnings, corrections, or when the user mentions remembering something for future sessions.
why_zh: 不是事后总结，而是捕获机制：在错误发生的当下就标记，再通过主动提醒闭环。记忆不是靠它自觉。
why_en: It captures corrections at the moment they happen, not after the fact, then closes the loop with a nudge. Memory depends on your.
limit_zh: 只记录你明确纠正过的内容，不会自动发现隐性错误；且必须手动跑 /reflect 才写入，忘了跑就白记。
limit_en: Only captures explicit corrections, not implicit errors. Requires manual /reflect to persist—skip it and it's lost. CLAUDE.md grows unbounded; you.
